name: intake-1678
about: 1678 alone in TELEOP drives into the NEUTRAL ZONE's FUEL with its intake held: the arm comes down on its pivot's position loop (the extension rides out on its pin and slot), the silicone roller rolls FUEL up over the kicker bar, the roller floor carries them back; once the hopper's CANrange has seen FUEL the tunnel prefills; the lid goes up on the climber once it holds 40; then it turns with its load and lets go (M3c).
